row.name: Animal Bond
row.effect: Calm a single aggressive, non-sapient animal within 10 feet. It will not attack unless provoked further.

levels.name: Animal Bond
levels.description: The Force-user connects with the minds and emotions of non-sapient creatures, radiating peace to pacify aggressive beasts or forming a temporary alliance to gain their cooperation.
levels.effect: Calm a single aggressive, non-sapient animal within 10 feet. It will not attack unless provoked further.

levels.name: Animal Bond
levels.description: The Force-user connects with the minds and emotions of non-sapient creatures, radiating peace to pacify aggressive beasts or forming a temporary alliance to gain their cooperation.
levels.effect: Range extends to 30 feet. You can compel a calmed animal to perform a simple, non-suicidal task (e.g., fetch, guard, move away).

levels.name: Animal Bond
levels.description: The Force-user connects with the minds and emotions of non-sapient creatures, radiating peace to pacify aggressive beasts or forming a temporary alliance to gain their cooperation.
levels.effect: Affect an entire pack or group of animals (up to 6) within 30 feet, or calm a single massive, highly aggressive beast (e.g., a rancor).

levels.name: Animal Bond
levels.description: The Force-user connects with the minds and emotions of non-sapient creatures, radiating peace to pacify aggressive beasts or forming a temporary alliance to gain their cooperation.
levels.effect: You can perceive through the senses of a bonded animal up to 1 mile away, and issue complex mental commands to multiple beasts.
